meaning: The number 736 has no well-established or known symbolic meaning in biblical or Jewish tradition.
description: In biblical numerology and Jewish gematria, it is primarily simple numbers and certain specific numbers (such as 7, 12, 40, 613, etc.) that have recognized symbolic meaning. The number 736 does not appear as a prominent symbolic number in the Bible or in traditional Jewish teaching. It occurs in Ezra 2:66 as the count of horses that those returning from exile brought with them, but this is a concrete enumeration rather than a symbolic use of the number. Although one can find Hebrew words or phrases through gematria that add up to 736, there is no widely recognized or authoritative symbolic interpretation associated with this number.

footnotes.text: In Ezra 2:66 it is mentioned that those who returned from the Babylonian exile had 736 horses. The parallel text in Nehemiah 7:68 also mentions horses, but the numbers vary somewhat between manuscripts.
